comment: Golden fixtures for RRULE expansion (ADR 0004 amendment). Each case is a stored routine definition — ONE `rrule` blob with exactly two newline-separated lines: `DTSTART:YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS` (floating local, no Z/TZID) + `RRULE:<body>` — and the local YYYY-MM-DD dates the engine must produce inside the inclusive window [from, to]. The SAME cases must pass on BOTH engines: the Rust crate (packages/api-core/src/routines.rs::occurrence_dates, asserted in routines.rs tests) and the npm rrule runner (apps/web/app/modules/routines/rrule-preview.ts). Expansion is floating local civil time; the tzdb is never used. UNTIL may stay Z-form inside the RRULE body (the Rust crate needs the UTC instant; DTSTART itself must never be Z). exdates are gone.
